description: The design check on a canvas page, at desktop and phone width: text contrast (WCAG), text too small, overlapping text, near-miss alignment, uneven gaps, shapes off the page, pictures without alt text, tap targets under 24px, the h1. Each issue names its shapes, so you can fix them with sketchxflow_canvas_apply. Free.
name: sketchxflow_canvas_check
title: Check a canvas page's design
